title: Introduction to Machine Learning
content: Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence that uses statistical models to enable computers to learn from data.

title: Natural Language Processing Basics
content: Natural language processing allows machines to understand and interpret human language using tokenization and lemmatization.

title: Information Retrieval Systems
content: An information retrieval system ranks relevant documents for a user query using algorithms like TF-IDF and PageRank.

title: Deep Learning in Computer Vision
content: Deep learning models like convolutional neural networks have revolutionized image recognition and computer vision tasks.
